Name: Early 2000s
Description: Peak flip‑phone era. Bring the hits (or deep cuts) from roughly 2000–2009.

Name: European Summer
Description: Soundtrack your Euro trip. Think beaches, clubs, terraces, and sunset drinks across the continent.

Name: Marketing Jams
Description: Songs used in ads, branding moments, or campaigns that stuck in your head long after the commercial ended.

Name: Songs Older Than the Player Submitting the Song
Description: Dig into the archives. Submit a track that dropped before you were even born and prove good music is timeless.

Name: One‑Word Song Titles
Description: Keep it simple. The entire title must be just one word.

Name: Festival Set Closers
Description: Big energy only. The kind of song that ends a set with hands up, voices gone, and no one wanting to leave.

Name: Duets or Group Vocals Only
Description: No solo acts. Every track must feature multiple voices working together, whether harmonizing or trading lines.

Name: Alternative Rock
Description: Guitars, edge, and attitude. From grunge-adjacent to indie mainstream, keep it alt.

Name: City Songs (Song references a city explicitly)
Description: Name a city in the song, title or lyrics. Take us somewhere specific.

Name: Wild Card Round
Description: No rules. No theme. Just submit your best track and let chaos decide.
